name: POS order panel (v16)
describe: The 384px order panel of the POS register (OrderPanel.tsx): order-type pills, customer select, pax stepper, cart lines with edit, quantity stepper and delete, Clear cart, the comment button with Total and the full-width Add New Order button.
Pinned to the end edge of the register, 100vh minus 4rem tall; shows the running order while a server taps items. The empty cart is the pos-screen-register-empty screen.
